query:
UPDATE users SET
            failed_attempts = failed_attempts + 1,
            locked_at = CASE
                WHEN locked_at IS NULL AND failed_attempts + 1 >= $2 THEN now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
                ELSE locked_at
            END,
            updated_at = now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
         WHERE id = $1
         RETURNING failed_attempts, locked_at
